title: For each department, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and
question: For each department, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget code, and what is the corresponding administrative department name, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.error: RuntimeError('Own Anchor/raw produced noSQL; terminal generation failure')
prediction.query_budget_protocol: 3 independently per Anchor/raw/full; maximum9, not sharedRQ4B3

access_trace.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.COURSE = '18'
LIMIT 50
access_trace.normalized_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.COURSE = '18' LIMIT 50

access_trace.sql:
SELECT STDDEV(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS stddev_budget, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.COURSE = '18'
  AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
access_trace.normalized_sql: SELECT STDDEV(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS stddev_budget, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS a ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.COURSE = '18' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
